example: No doubt this book was tough to read considering its content. But I can't deny that it was cleverly written from the view of a madman. Some aspects of the author's writing were ingenious, for example how he changed the tense from first person sometimes, as though Bateman were outside his own body. It's hard to say whether all or only some of these horrific events actually occurred or if they were all in his mind...there are many instances where it is quite obvious he is only imagining. It's tough for the reader to sort out the real from the "fantasy", just as it was for Bateman. I felt nauseous several times while reading this book, but I have to say that I'm glad I read it.
Label: Good
